run_spot_ros_visualizer: run the SpotRosVisualizer to display ROS camera images from a Boston Dynamics Spot robot in real time
run_visualizer_headless: run the SpotRosVisualizer in headless mode without opening a GUI window for server-side image processing
run_visualizer_record: run the SpotRosVisualizer with the --record flag to automatically capture and save video of robot camera feeds
review_visualizer_mixin_overlay_text: review the VisualizerMixin overlay_text method that overlays multi-line text on OpenCV images with configurable color and size
review_spotrosvisualizer_generate_compos: review the SpotRosVisualizer generate_composite method that stacks raw and processed ROS camera images into a single composite view
